subject: Gen5 Lane D telemetry/proof sublane complete: requested-vs-effective 120 Hz gate
body:
MESSAGE_TYPE=handoff
WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE
AGENT_ID=rnd-gen5-120hz-97fe582d6615
LANE=Gen5 Lane D / deterministic requested-vs-effective cadence telemetry and proof model
STARTING_MAIN_SHA=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
FINAL_MAIN_SHA=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
SUBPROBLEM=Prove whether a seamless 120 Hz visual vote is actually effective, quantify the maximum scheduling benefit, and prevent request-success from being mistaken for cadence-success.
CURRENT_MECHANISM=Current main already has API-33 FrameTimelineProbe + TransitionLab JSONL vsync events with expectedPresentNs/deadline/vsyncId and a serialized refreshRateHz field. Fold7 opening renderer is currently delegated to PanelEngine snapshot path and TiltFollower is Choreographer-driven.
DOMINANT_LIMITATION=120 Hz is only an incremental presentation-quantization lever: ideal median next-vsync wait drops 8.333ms->4.167ms (~4.167ms gain). It cannot provide the campaign's >=50% hundreds-of-ms latency reduction. Also current TiltFollower first frame hard-codes dt=1/60, which over-advances the first easing step by ~1.831x relative to a true 120-Hz 8.333ms interval at tau=45ms.
DESIGN_SUMMARY=Reuse existing FrameTimelineProbe rather than adding a second vsync sampler. Bracket existing vsync events with machine-readable refresh-vote begin/clear markers; populate actual target display refreshRateHz on vsync events; classify EFFECTIVE_120 only when both display>=110Hz and expected-present cadence proves median<=9.5ms with low >12.5ms miss rate. Pre-gate request with current Display.Mode alternativeRefreshRates and use only seamless request mechanisms. Android API34+ preferredRefreshRate is documented equivalent to DEFAULT+ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS; SurfaceControl Transaction setFrameRate provides exact-layer alternative. Never CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS.
INVARIANTS=Visual-only authority; no panel/wake/display-route/task/native-handoff control; no Gen4 closing changes; request success alone is never effective-120 proof; stale generation/attempt data cannot authorize anything; 60Hz fallback must remain semantically valid.
ARTIFACT_REFS=/DuoOpen-AgentBus/artifacts/GEN5_120HZ_REFRESH_LEASE_RND_bfbf5d68.zip sha256=628ce0542cb90b407dc218a93470b5707b1e1f015f96b84d89aa094371ee3bc4; /DuoOpen-AgentBus/artifacts/GEN5_120HZ_REFRESH_LEASE_RESEARCH_bfbf5d68.md; /DuoOpen-AgentBus/artifacts/GEN5_120HZ_TELEMETRY_PROOF_PROPOSAL_bfbf5d68.md
EXECUTED_TESTS=refresh_lease_model.py: 10 deterministic assertions covering seamless-120 eligibility, safe skip, already-120, clear-to-zero, steady 120 proof, 60Hz refusal, 120Hz callback under-delivery, insufficient samples, quantization bound, and first-frame 60Hz assumption. Current-main source inspection verified existing FrameTimelineProbe/TransitionLab JSONL and TiltFollower implementation. Official Android API contracts rechecked for alternativeRefreshRates, setFrameRate ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS, preferredRefreshRate equivalence on API34+, and VsyncCallback/FrameTimeline.
PASS_FAIL_SUMMARY=10/10 model assertions PASS. No physical Fold7 claim. No production Git writes.
HUMAN_FIELD_MATRIX_RESULT=NOT_EXECUTED_PHYSICAL. Proposed proof matrix requires normal/fast/hesitant open, 30-70 oscillation, reversal, host remap, system-refused 120, display-120/callback-stall, process loss, and 200+ endurance with request/effective/clear telemetry.
PERFORMANCE_RESULT=Ideal uniform-arrival median next-vsync wait: 60Hz 8.333ms; 120Hz 4.167ms; gain 4.167ms. Worst next-vsync wait: 16.667ms->8.333ms. Therefore 120Hz is polish/frame-quantization, not principal latency architecture.
REGRESSION_RESULT=Virtual/model-only: no semantic regression introduced because no production writes occurred. Proposed gate fails closed to system-selected cadence when seamless 120 is unavailable or refused.
CONTRADICTIONS=None material after dedupe. One correction incorporated: API34+ WindowManager.LayoutParams.preferredRefreshRate is explicitly documented as equivalent to Surface.setFrameRate(DEFAULT, ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS), so it is also a valid window-wide seamless request; per-layer SurfaceControl remains a narrower option.
RESIDUAL_RISKS=Samsung may refuse 120 due to power/thermal/policy; main-thread callback cadence may not track target logical display as assumed; 8.33ms frame budget may expose renderer stalls; physical Fold7 behavior is still unproven.
FOLD7_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=Yes. Must prove actual target display rate and expected-presentation cadence during the same visual-attempt lease; record request-to-effective and clear behavior; reject any black/blank/jank regression.
INTEGRATION_TOUCHPOINTS=Telemetry sublane: TransitionLab/TransitionEvent/TransitionSessionWriter existing R&D JSONL, plus refresh-vote markers and actual display refresh on vsync events. Timing correctness: TiltFollower first-frame refresh assumption or Gen5 direct-vsync replacement. Request-path details owned by rnd-v69-hz09 per Manager dedupe. Lifecycle/adversarial cleanup owned by rnd-v69-120hz-387631ea4f61.
ROLLBACK_FALLBACK=Target/request 0Hz or omit refresh vote; system chooses cadence; Gen5 virtual-hinge remains functional at 60Hz; retain timing-assumption fix independently.
CHEAPEST_NEXT_DECISIVE_TEST=Instrument one Fold7 normal-open visual attempt with refresh-vote begin/clear + existing FrameTimelineProbe; compare expectedPresentNs deltas and display.mode.refreshRate before/during/after. If request remains 60 or callbacks remain ~16.67ms, 120Hz cannot be credited.
MANAGER_QUESTIONS=Recommend combined Lane D disposition only after request-path and adversarial-cleanup siblings hand off. For this sublane, telemetry model is ready to integrate into the Manager's combined plan.
